description: Delney, Streetwise Lookout + Archivist of Oghma: Archivist of Oghma's mandatory 'gain 1 life, draw a card' trigger on an opponent's library search is a power-2 creature's triggered ability, so Delney doubles it. Unlike INT-0007/0008/0009/0010, this ability has no target, mode, or optional choice - both doubled instances resolve identically. Validates INT-0014.
artificial_state_elements: Evolving Wilds for playerB was chosen as an arbitrary source of an opponent library search; any qualifying search (tutor, fetchland, etc.) triggers Archivist of Oghma identically.
No other permanents, hand cards beyond what's listed, or players' boards were modeled.
material_characteristics: Archivist of Oghma's power is exactly 2, so its own triggered ability qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause

The trigger ('you gain 1 life and draw a card') is fully mandatory with no target, mode, or optional cost - the only real decision point Delney's doubling introduces here is the CR 603.3b trigger-ordering choice, which is order-independent for this specific effect
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the specific library-search source (any qualifying opponent search triggers identically)
All board state not directly involved in the interaction

legal_actions: Seat 2 activates Evolving Wilds ({T}, Sacrifice: search library for a basic land)
illegal_actions_to_reject: Any implicit assumption that Archivist of Oghma's trigger only fires once (Delney alone) rather than twice
expected.outcome_if_resolved: After seat 2 activates Evolving Wilds and both doubled Archivist of Oghma instances resolve: seat 1's life rises from 20 to 22 and hand grows from 0 to 2 cards.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d (a triggered ability may be stated to trigger an additional time; determine how many times, then trigger that many times)
CR 603.3b (a player puts each of their own simultaneously-pending triggered abilities on the stack in any order they choose)
